notes.title: Updated Русский & Deutsch Translations + Some Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019598/cd873656b14da766102e2a4a95b1fd9950b15670.jpg[/img]

A huuge thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/anonysaurus]Anonysaurus[/url] for the tremendous help with the Russian translation! <3

Here are the patch notes:
- Updated German and Russian translations
- Fixed some missing text in settings panels
- Added overhead instructional text for all currently supported languages

Unfortunately we were not able to fix the camera clipping for the boat scene yet; turned out to be a bit trickier than expected due to the way clipping is currently handled...it will have to wait until the next update.

David recently did an interview with DualShockers, where he talks about about localization and subtitles implementation in Unity: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/anonysaurus]Click[/url]

We highly appreciate all your feedback and bug reports, so please keep them coming and don't forget to leave a review if you've enjoyed your experience with Yi and the Thousand Moons. :)
